evidence.section: 3.2.2. Effect of adding Co, Ce, and Fe to the MMONi structure
evidence.text_snippet:
Fig. 9B shows the results for catalytic methanation using 
MMONiCo and MMONiFe. The material containing Co experienced 
better CO2 conversions (~80 % at 350 ◦C) than that containing Fe (50 % 
at 350 ◦C).
